subject.title: [Bug]: v2026.6.9 regression — Codex app-server runs stamp internal turns "webchat"-bound, so heartbeat notification sends to Discord are silently denied (cross-context)

question: Which open fix path should maintainers treat as canonical for the Codex internal-turn `webchat` binding regression?
rationale: Current main is still affected, but three open closing pull requests overlap and make different tradeoffs around scope, diagnostics, and proof, so deterministic issue cleanup should not pick a merge target by closing the issue early.

options.title: Review the scoped internal-turn fix
options.body: Treat `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102232` or an equivalent scoped patch as the preferred path because it preserves real WebChat containment while fixing heartbeat/cron/inter-session turns.

options.title: Sponsor the broader diagnostics fix
options.body: Use `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102217` if maintainers want the diagnostic-event addition bundled with the delivery repair despite its larger surface and current proof gap label.

options.title: Request one replacement branch
